input.body:
label: bug
file: src/notifications/templates.ts

The issue is with the reset password email link always using "http://localhost:3000" as a fallback for `BASE_URL` in `src/notifications/templates.ts`. This is set by `process.env.PUBLIC_URL ?? "http://localhost:3000"`. The root cause likely lies in the environment variable not being set correctly in the production or deployment environment, so the fallback localhost URL is used. The fix involves ensuring `PUBLIC_URL` is properly set or changing how the base URL is determined for production builds.

text:
label: bug
file: src/notifications/templates.ts
The password reset email link uses a hardcoded fallback "http://localhost:3000" when the environment variable PUBLIC_URL is not set, causing the email to contain a localhost URL. The issue stems from improper environment setup or fallback logic in src/notifications/templates.ts.
